svg.aria-label: Architecture of Second Look: a CSV is triaged by a deterministic engine into an evidence pack; a writer model or template drafts the narrative, which passes rule checks and an LLM judge before publication; investigators decide in the browser and every action is appended to an event log.
svg.text: How a referral moves through Second Look
linked claims · data gaps · QA sample
stable IDs · the only facts a model uses
AI review: GPT-6, Claude, Gemini, local
citations · figures in the pack · tone
pass shows · flag warns · fail = template
SQLite, keyed by pack + writer + judge
vanilla JS + SVG · no build · strict CSP
capacity plan: N reviews → share of dollars
dollar strip · today's picks · plain-language why
points to risk vs could explain it · data gaps
what each column does to the score
accept · reject (rating, reason) · needs evidence · status
append-only · exports Excel with formulas, Markdown
scores · ratings · evidence (works with no model)
API keys stay in .env on the server and never reach the browser. With no key, the rules review and the recorded AI run still work.
